name: Sportsmobile Sprinter conversion

attributes.value: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter RB 144in, EB 170in, LB 170in (factory AWD and diesel)
Ford Transit (RB/EB/LB, factory AWD, Trail Ready package), Ram ProMaster (RB/EB/LB), Chevy Express (4x4 builds)

Factory-direct, per-client builds; no third-party dealer network. Sportsmobile usually supplies the base van through preferred dealers (mandatory if financing). A small 'New Stock' inventory of completed vans is sold from Sportsmobile's own three locations.

attributes.unit: USD plus TT&L (Sprinter EB high-roof diesel AWD: van $78,400 + EB-110S conversion $78,500 + $7,500 options)

3 years / 36,000 miles on the conversion; appliances, 4x4 and the chassis are covered by their own manufacturers
Standard 200Ah AGM; lithium systems up to 1,600Ah offered, 24V and 48V available; solar up to ~500W depending on roof
Huntington, IN; Austin, TX; Gold Canyon, AZ (production, service and sales at all three)
